title: Densetsu no Stafy 2 - World 1-6
description:
This belongs to the Japanese version of the game. This BG is also used in 1-5. Used Lunar Magic's bitmap pasting feature to rip this BG. This BG now uses tile F8, instead of the new and empty tile 100 and that tile is free to use. Also, removed 2 colors from palette 3 in favor of back area color, which is the sky.
No credit required.
